method: Five fresh foreground desktop tabs at1920x902 and one at390x844, regrouped by the viewport recorded in each snapshot. Local no-store byte-range HTTP server; historical measure-performance.js at8db57b3; no network throttling; fixed5s/15s snapshots after DOMContentLoaded. Totals exclude HTML; ResourceTiming includes only completed responses and cross-origin sizes may be zero. Desktop Chrome viewport simulation, not physical mobile.
